words.gloss: at the time of ruin or distress

literal: At the time of ruin, injury-not-fearing courage, at the time of defeat, to the ancient army except, is rare.
translation: The courage that fears no wounds in times of ruin is rare for any but an ancient, time-tested army in times of defeat.
modern: அழிவு வரும் காலத்தில் காயங்களுக்கு அஞ்சாத வீரமும், தோல்வி ஏற்படும் காலத்தில் தளராத மன உறுதியும் பழமையான படைக்கு அல்லாமல் வேறு யாருக்கும் கிடைப்பது அரிது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the unique quality of a seasoned, traditional army. It states that when ruin or defeat is imminent, the steadfast courage that does not fear wounds or suffering is extremely rare to find in any force other than such an ancient, time-tested army. The key words 'உலைவிடம்' and 'தொலைவிடம்' refer to critical moments of distress and defeat, while 'வன்கண்' represents the unyielding fortitude required to withstand them.
